title: Completion inequalities for the depth-codimension finiteness cutoff
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof tracks chains of primes across completion and splits all dimension terms into base and formal-fibre contributions. It constructs minimal lifts for one inequality, then handles the competing formal-fibre dimensions using the Serre bound and a separate large-fibre case. The minimization is not preserved by a routine faithful-flatness argument.
